guide_user_quickstart_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Start tracking your inventory in Stokendra in less than 1 minute.

1️⃣ Create Stock Card: Open 'Stock Cards' from the sidebar and click 'New Card' to define an item.
2️⃣ Record Stock Entry: In 'Stock Movements', click 'New Movement' to log incoming inventory.
3️⃣ Record Stock Exit: When items are issued to personnel or departments, log an 'Exit' movement.

💡 Tip: When items drop below their critical stock limit, the Dashboard warns you in red automatically.
guide_user_stockcards_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Define inventory items, unit measurements, and safety stock thresholds.

1️⃣ Add New Card: Specify product code, name, unit (Piece, Meter, Box, etc.) and minimum stock level.
2️⃣ Category Grouping (Optional): Group products under a parent category (e.g., 'Computer Parts' > 'RAM', 'SSD').
3️⃣ Instant Keystroke Search: Search any letter to get instant results in 0.005 ms via memory indexing.

💡 Tip: Double-click any stock card to immediately view its complete historical movement ledger.
guide_user_movements_title: Stock Movements — Entry, Exit & Bulk Operations
guide_user_movements_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Accurately record incoming and outgoing warehouse stock changes.

1️⃣ Stock Entry [E]: Adds purchased or transferred items into the warehouse (Green badge).
2️⃣ Stock Exit [X]: Deducts items assigned to departments or personnel (Red badge).
3️⃣ Bulk Entry/Exit: Update quantities for dozens of items simultaneously on a single screen.
4️⃣ Excel Import: Fill out the ready Excel template to import thousands of records in one click.

💡 Tip: If you make a mistake, simply delete or edit the movement; stock levels recalculate automatically.
guide_user_services_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Track equipment sent for warranty, external repair, or routine maintenance.

1️⃣ Create Service Record: Log device name, serial number, vendor, failure description, and date.
2️⃣ Update Status: When the unit returns, mark its status as 'Repaired', 'Replaced', or 'Returned'.
3️⃣ Bulk Actions: Select multiple devices to batch-update vendor, date, or status.
4️⃣ Print & Export: Generate clean printable service summary sheets or export records to Excel.

💡 Tip: Keep maintenance records detailed to prevent lost equipment and warranty disputes.
guide_user_backup_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Safeguard against data loss and keep the database performing at peak speed.

1️⃣ Automatic Daily Backup: The app silently creates a daily database backup (.db) on first startup.
2️⃣ Manual ZIP / Excel Backup: Download an all-inclusive ZIP archive of all tables anytime from Settings.
3️⃣ Database Maintenance: Use 'Integrity Check' and 'Optimize Database' to compact and speed up the DB.

💡 Tip: Periodically copy the downloaded ZIP backup to an external USB flash drive or secure cloud storage.
guide_user_reports_title: Reports & Analytics — Dashboard and Print Forms
guide_user_reports_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Turn transactions into actionable visual charts and formal printable documents.

1️⃣ Dashboard Overview: Monitor top-consumed items, department distributions, and critical stock warnings.
2️⃣ Filtered Reports: Query consumption between two dates broken down by department.
3️⃣ Unpaged Print / PDF: Print outputs always include ALL records matching your filter without pagination limits.
4️⃣ Export to Excel: Export formatted spreadsheet reports with a single click.

💡 Tip: Apply 'Date Range' and 'Department' filters before printing to get the exact report you need.
guide_dev_perf_desc:
⚡ High Performance Highlights:
• .NET 10 LTS Runtime: JIT optimizations, Dynamic PGO, and hardware-accelerated vectorization.
• SearchIndex<T>: 1..32 character prefix memory dictionary (0.005 ms O(1) lookup time).
• EnsureLoadedAsync: Visited tabs stay in memory; transitions run stutter-free at 144 FPS.
• DataEvents: Mutations mark affected domain caches dirty in the background with zero CPU overhead.
• SQLite WAL Mode: Concurrent read/write, 256MB mmap_size, and B-Tree covering indexes (IX_Movements).
guide_dev_mvvm_desc:
🏗️ Architecture Patterns:
• CommunityToolkit.Mvvm: [ObservableProperty] and [RelayCommand] compile-time source generators.
• Microsoft Dependency Injection: Repositories, services, and ViewModels resolved via constructor injection.
• ViewLocator: Compiled expression tree cache for IL-level instantaneous View instantiation.
guide_dev_folders_desc:
📂 Codebase Organization:
• Views: Avalonia UI XAML pages and user controls (.axaml).
• ViewModels: Application logic, UI commands, and data binding orchestration.
• Models: POCO domain models mapped 1:1 to database tables.
• Data: SQLite connection pooling (Database.cs), migrations (Database.Migrations.cs), and repositories.
• Services: ClosedXML spreadsheet engine and ZipArchive backup services.
• Infrastructure: Search indexing, localization engine, AppInfo, and dialog services.
guide_dev_lang_desc:
🌐 Language Infrastructure:
• JSON Resource Dictionaries: 'lang_tr.json' and 'lang_en.json' maintain 570+ symmetrical keys.
• XAML Markup Extension: '{infra:L key}' binds localized text at design-time and runtime.
• Built-in Fallbacks: Gracefully falls back to compiled string dictionaries if keys are missing.
guide_dev_db_desc:
🗄️ Persistence Layer:
• Dapper Micro-ORM: Raw SQL performance and minimal memory footprint.
• Automated Migration Engine: Reads SQLite 'user_version' pragma to apply sequential schema migrations safely.
• Cryptography: Passwords protected via v4 Pbkdf2 SHA-512 (600,000 iterations).
guide_dev_roadmap_desc:
🚀 v7.5.0 .NET 10 LTS Achievements:
  - Upgraded target framework to Microsoft .NET 10 LTS (net10.0).
  - JIT optimizations, Dynamic PGO, and memory footprint reductions.
  - Modernized one-shot Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2 API with zero heap allocation.
  - 100% Self-Contained Windows installer with embedded CoreCLR (no external .NET needed).
  - 113/113 unit and integration tests verified on .NET 10.

⚡ v7.4.9 Performance & Architecture:
  - In-memory SearchIndex<T> providing 25ms keystroke response and O(1) prefix lookup.
  - EnsureLoadedAsync & DataEvents delivering stutter-free 144 FPS tab navigation.
  - ClosedXML Circuit Breaker, File-Lock protection, and culture-invariant parsers.

🔮 Upcoming Roadmap:
1. Barcode & QR Code Integration: Instant item and movement scanning via USB scanners.
2. Multi-Device Sync: Shared local network SQLite database or PostgreSQL adapter.
3. Automated Email Alerts: Automatic email triggers on low stock thresholds.

guide_user_notes_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Built-in scratchpad for daily warehouse operations, supplier notes, and reminders.

1️⃣ Add Note: Provide a title and description to record upcoming shipments or tasks.
2️⃣ Quick Search: Instantly search across all stored notes by title or content.
3️⃣ Secure Storage: Notes are saved permanently in the database; they persist through updates and restarts.

💡 Tip: Tag notes by department or product to make searches and tracking effortless.
guide_user_users_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Role-based authorization and credential protection for staff.

1️⃣ Administrator (Admin): Manages system configuration, user accounts, database maintenance, and logs.
2️⃣ Standard User: Focuses strictly on daily stock entries, exits, and service logs.
3️⃣ High-Grade Security: Passwords hashed with modern PBKDF2 SHA-512; plaintext is never stored.
4️⃣ Emergency Recovery: Reset forgotten passwords anytime using the Master Security Code defined in Settings.

💡 Tip: Note down your Master Security Code in a safe place immediately after initial setup.
guide_user_updates_desc:
🎯 Purpose: Keep Stokendra running on the newest and fastest release effortlessly.

1️⃣ Silent Notification: A blue banner alerts you at the top of the main screen when a new release is available.
2️⃣ One-Click Update: Click 'Download & Install' to download the setup package in the background and launch it.
3️⃣ Zero Data Risk: Updates strictly preserve your local database, stock balances, and settings.

💡 Tip: Check release notes to discover newly added performance features and productivity improvements.
guide_dev_excel_desc:
📊 Excel Data Engine:
• ClosedXML Integration: Protected by File-Lock Guard and error Circuit Breaker.
• Flexible Column Mapping: Automatically maps Turkish and English column synonyms.
• Culture-Neutral Numbers: Seamlessly converts OLE serial dates, ISO timestamps, and comma/dot decimals.
